faqItems.a1: Absolutely safe. Your funds always remain in your own exchange account. Hoot uses a non-custodial model, only executing trades via API without fund withdrawal access. We use AES-256-GCM military-grade encryption to protect your API keys.
faqItems.q2: How is AI trading different from regular quant?
faqItems.a2: Hoot's AI trading features a proprietary multi-role debate system — Bull, Bear, Technical Analyst, Contrarian, and Risk Manager each analyze independently, then debate and vote. More comprehensive and objective than single-model or fixed-rule strategies. Four modes available: Solo, Debate, Research, and Grid.
faqItems.a3: We recommend at least $100 to ensure adequate funds for proper position management. Hoot registration is completely free. Free users can run 2 strategies, with Gas Fee of 25% only charged on profits.
faqItems.a4: Hoot uses a "profit-only" Gas Fee model — fees of 20-25% are only charged when strategies profit on closing positions. No fees on losing trades. Pro membership at $19.99/month reduces the rate to 20%. 50% of Gas Fees go to the staking reward pool.
faqItems.q5: What if I lose money? Is there risk protection?
faqItems.a5: Hoot has multiple built-in risk controls: every strategy requires stop-loss that auto-closes positions when triggered; Research mode has AI risk review that can veto high-risk trades; supports one-click emergency close. We recommend proper position sizing and diversification. Currently supports Binance Futures and DEXes (Hyperliquid, Aster, Lighter), all using non-custodial mode.

faqItems.q1: Is my money safe? Can Hoot access my funds?
faqItems.a1: Absolutely safe. Hoot uses a non-custodial model — your funds always remain in your own exchange account. We only have "trading" permission via API, with no withdrawal access. API Keys are encrypted using AES-256-GCM military-grade encryption.
faqItems.q2: How does Hoot's AI trading work?
faqItems.a2: Hoot offers four AI trading modes: Solo (single AI fast decision, ideal for short-term), Debate (multi-model voting, more robust), Research (5-analyst research + 5-role debate + risk review, most rigorous), and Grid (AI dynamically adjusts grid parameters, auto buy-low sell-high). All trading decisions are made autonomously by AI, running 24/7.
faqItems.q3: What's the minimum to start? How do beginners get started?
faqItems.a3: We recommend at least $100 USDT to ensure proper position management. Hoot registration is completely free and comes with 20 HOOT. Three steps to start: 1) Register (email/Telegram/wallet); 2) Connect exchange API Key (enable futures trading only); 3) Choose an AI mode, create a strategy, and launch. Free users can run 2 strategies simultaneously, with fees only on profits.
faqItems.q4: What is Gas Fee? How is it charged?
faqItems.a4: Gas Fee is Hoot's core fee mechanism — we only earn when you earn. Free users pay 25% of profits, Pro members ($19.99/month) pay 20%. No fees on losing trades. Staking HOOT tokens can provide up to 10% additional fee discount. 50% of Gas Fees go to the staking reward pool.
faqItems.q5: What if I lose money? Is there stop-loss protection?
faqItems.a5: Hoot provides multiple risk protections: 1) Every strategy requires a stop-loss setting (recommended 5-15%), auto-closes when triggered; 2) Research mode has built-in 3-party risk review, AI Risk Manager can veto high-risk trades; 3) Emergency one-click close all positions (in App or TG Bot /closeall); 4) Recommend keeping each strategy under 30% of total capital to diversify risk. Losses are part of trading — proper risk management is key.
faqItems.q6: How to connect exchange API Key?
faqItems.a6: Go to Wallet > API Key Management, select exchange (currently supports Binance Futures and DEXes like Hyperliquid/Aster/Lighter). When creating API Key on exchange, only enable "Futures Trading" permission, never enable "Withdrawal". Enter API Key and Secret in Hoot, test connection to confirm.
faqItems.q7: How to deposit funds? What methods are supported?
faqItems.a7: Hoot has two funding sources: 1) Platform balance — go to Wallet page, deposit USDT via TRC20/BEP20/ERC20 chains, minimum 10 USDT, usually arrives in 1-5 minutes; 2) Exchange funds — after connecting API Key, Hoot reads your exchange balance directly for trading, no need to transfer to platform. Most users just need to connect API Key to start. Platform deposits are mainly for membership and credits.
faqItems.q8: Where can I view trade history and profits?
faqItems.a8: The Trading page shows real-time monitoring of all running strategies and positions. Dashboard homepage displays total assets and profit curves. Click any strategy to view detailed trade history and P&L per order. Enable Telegram Bot notifications (@HootCool_bot) for real-time trade alerts, or use /trade command to check current positions anytime.
faqItems.q9: How to get and use HOOT tokens?
faqItems.a9: HOOT is the platform ecosystem token. Earn by: 20 HOOT on registration, 2-8 HOOT daily check-in (increases with streaks), 10 HOOT each for binding Telegram/wallet/email, 15 HOOT per referral. Use for: staking in the 50% Gas Fee reward pool (1.0x-3.0x weight), fee discounts, subscription payments.
faqItems.q10: How to get help with issues?
faqItems.a10: Three ways: Help Center for articles and FAQs; email support@hoot.ai (response within 24 hours); Telegram community for instant help. For emergencies, use /closeall in TG Bot to close all positions.

modeInfo.soloDesc: A single AI model performs technical + derivatives data analysis on monitored coins each cycle, outputting trading decisions (direction, leverage, SL/TP) in one shot. Fast response, short decision chain — best for trending markets.
modeInfo.debateDesc: Multiple AI models independently analyze the same market data, each providing trading direction and confidence, then reach consensus through weighted voting. Cross-validation reduces single-model bias — best for ranging or unclear markets.
modeInfo.gridDesc: AI-driven grid trading strategy that automatically places limit buy/sell orders within a price range, profiting from price oscillations. Supports uniform/gaussian/pyramid grid distributions, with AI dynamically adjusting grid boundaries each cycle. Best for ranging markets.
